source: Retained public get_model_schema response, backend190, 2026-09-19; only native contract names/protocol/input_schema retained. No caller requests, handles or credentials.

model.description: Exact pinned model identity; omit to use this fixed deployment.

mode.description: Exact Cosmos workflow; prefer its dedicated MCP tool.

prompt.description: Scene description or robotics instruction. Structured upsampled prompts are accepted as strings.

size.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT; each dimension is a multiple of 16, width 256–1280, height 256–720 and area <=921600.

anyOf.description: Reference image or MP4 selected by mode. Use the final immutable HTTPS URL; redirects and customer-local paths are rejected.

artifact_id.description: Caller-owned immutable artifact UUID returned after upload finalization.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes.

media_type.description: Media type of the uploaded bytes.

compression.description: Artifact input must be stored without transport compression.

anyOf.description: Tenant-owned artifact reference. Upload and finalize the bytes before submitting this model call.

input_reference.description: Reference image or MP4 selected by mode. Use the final immutable HTTPS URL; redirects and customer-local paths are rejected. Prefer an artifact reference for nontrivial files so clients never serialize file bytes through an LLM.

vision_path.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for input_reference. Only an HTTPS URL is accepted; a customer-local path never is.

generate_sound.description: Generate synchronized AAC audio for text-to-video or image-to-video.

condition_frame_indexes_vision.description: Selected latent frames used for V2V continuation, not full-trajectory preservation. [0] reads one source pixel frame; [0,1] reads five. Unconditioned future motion is generated.

condition_video_keep.description: Decode the needed reference frames from the beginning or end.

controls.description: One or more typed transfer controls.

anyOf.description: Optional control image/video. Required for depth, segmentation and WSM; edge/blur may derive from input_reference. Use the final immutable HTTPS URL; redirects and customer-local paths are rejected.

artifact_id.description: Caller-owned immutable artifact UUID returned after upload finalization.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes.

media_type.description: Media type of the uploaded bytes.

compression.description: Artifact input must be stored without transport compression.

anyOf.description: Tenant-owned artifact reference. Upload and finalize the bytes before submitting this model call.

reference.description: Optional control image/video. Required for depth, segmentation and WSM; edge/blur may derive from input_reference. Use the final immutable HTTPS URL; redirects and customer-local paths are rejected. Prefer an artifact reference for nontrivial files so clients never serialize file bytes through an LLM.

control_weight.description: Nonnegative relative control weight; at least one selected control must be positive.

edge_threshold.description: Edge extraction preset; valid only for edge control.

blur_strength.description: Blur extraction preset; valid only for blur control.

items.description: One typed transfer control. Control types may not repeat in a request.

resolution.description: Legacy transfer resolution hint retained for compatibility. The hosted runtime uses explicit size for output dimensions (448x256 when omitted); this hint does not preserve source aspect ratio.

share_vision_temporal_positions.description: Share control/target temporal positions in transfer mode.

emphasize_control_in_prompt.description: Append the pinned control-adherence directive in transfer mode.

output_delivery.description: Video delivery only: use the operation artifact store or legacy inline text-to-video. Omit for text-to-image, which returns the legacy PNG JSON envelope.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse this key when retrying the same submission to avoid duplicate work.

wait_seconds.description: Wait briefly for completion; otherwise poll get_operation using the returned operation ID.

input_schema.description: Generate or transform image/video from text and bounded media controls; large MP4 results are artifacts. Pinned Cosmos3 Nano media API. Media inputs use tenant artifacts or immutable HTTPS URLs; large MP4 outputs use the operation artifact store. Submit once, then poll the returned operation ID and retrieve its result when completed.
